title: Android Timeline upload batch
description: The request body of POST /api/v1/events/batch. Replaying an identical batch_id, or resending the same events under a new batch_id, must never create duplicates.

protocol_version.description: Wire protocol version shared by collector and server.

batch_id.description: Unique per upload attempt group. Reused verbatim on retry so the server can recognise a replay.

collector_version.description: Version of the collector that produced this batch.
